description: Fragment of a fresco detached from a chapel wall. Of the Virgin enthroned, the head and hands are well preserved; of the Christ Child once seated on her lap, only the feet survive, the rest of the paint layer having flaked away. A later repainting covers the lower edge.
definition: the Virgin enthroned with the Christ-child seated on her lap

variantes.description: Fragment de fresque déposé d'un mur de chapelle. De la Vierge en trône, la tête et les mains sont bien conservées ; de l'Enfant Jésus autrefois assis sur ses genoux, seuls les pieds subsistent, le reste de la couche picturale s'étant écaillé. Un repeint postérieur couvre le bord inférieur.

This fragment of a detached chapel fresco keeps the head and hands of the enthroned Virgin. Of the Christ Child who once sat on her lap only the feet survive; everything else has flaked off. The lower edge is overpainted.
Fragment of a fresco detached from a chapel wall. The Virgin is enthroned, and the Christ Child, seated on her lap, is fully preserved. A later repainting covers the lower edge.

Fragment of a fresco detached from a chapel wall. Of the Virgin enthroned, the head and hands are well preserved; of the Christ Child once seated on her lap, only the feet survive. No trace of the original inscription remains.
Fragment of a fresco detached from a chapel wall. Of the Virgin enthroned, the head and hands are well preserved; of the Christ Child, who was perhaps seated on her lap, only the feet survive.
